title: Concept: Hundred percent discount applied
description: A discount percentage of one hundred in an order record in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: A full discount on a paid product is either a misconfigured promotion or a tampered parameter, and both show that the discount value is not bounded server-side.
